lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: A semi-regular grid of high-luminance circular spots posterior to the gill slits, arranged in approximately five horizontal rows and multiple vertical columns, creating a 2D coordinate-like array of localized maxima.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Vertical bands of elevated luminance intersect horizontal spot rows to form a faint checkerboard grid across the mid-lateral flank; these intersections coincide with the highest-intensity pixel clusters.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: Three distinct longitudinal ridges are visible on the upper flank, characterized by a sharp vertical pixel intensity gradient with high luminance on the dorsal edge and distinct shadow on the ventral edge, running parallel to the dorsal contour.

other_distinctive_markers: The left pectoral fin displays a high spatial density of small, high-luminance spots, which contrasts with the larger and more widely spaced spot distribution on the primary lateral flank.
